notes: Canonical local ambience library for Nocturne alpha.12-dev. Tonight remains eight bundled recorded CC0 files. Generated beds are optional and honestly labeled; experimental sounds require the explicit Experimental shelf. Quarantined originals and seam-baked repair candidates remain server-denied and are detached to the companion evidence bundle in the slim tester release until human audition.

sounds.name: Window Rain Noise

sounds.name: Heavy Rain Noise
sounds.description: Procedural heavy rain-like starter bed generated locally during install.

sounds.name: Soft Pink Rain Noise
sounds.description: Procedural rain/noise bed generated locally during install. Alpha.8 audition found this reads closer to soft pink-noise-like wash than to a convincing dark rain rumble.
sounds.notes: Alpha.8 metadata correction only: ID and file preserved for compatibility; display name/description changed after audition. Generated entirely by scripts/generate_noise.py.

sounds.name: Soft Air Noise
sounds.description: Procedural soft air/wind-like bed generated locally during install.

sounds.name: Dark Rain Rumble Noise
sounds.description: Procedural pink-spectrum noise generated locally during install. Alpha.8 audition found this slot reads more like a dark rain/rumble bed in the mixer than the previous plain Pink Noise label.
sounds.notes: Alpha.8 metadata correction only: ID and file preserved for compatibility; display name/description changed after audition. Generated entirely by scripts/generate_noise.py.

sounds.name: Brown Noise (Deep/Subtle)
sounds.description: Procedural low-frequency brown noise. Best on headphones or speakers with bass response.
sounds.notes: Low-frequency brown noise may sound very quiet on small laptop/phone speakers.

sounds.name: White Noise
sounds.description: Generated locally by scripts/generate_noise.py during install.

sounds.name: Low Rumble Bed
sounds.description: Procedural low/sub rumble bed with slow swells in the 22–130 Hz region. Thunder-adjacent texture, not a recording of real thunder; no sharp peaks.
sounds.notes: Best on headphones or speakers with bass response; very low frequencies may be quiet on small laptop/phone speakers.

sounds.name: Distant Train Bed
sounds.description: Procedural soft low rolling rail texture with a gentle rhythmic cadence. Synthetic bed — no horn, no metallic screech, no identifiable train events.

sounds.name: Soft Traffic Bed
sounds.description: Procedural distant-city traffic wash, very low and smooth. Anonymous wash only — no honks, sirens, or identifiable vehicles.

sounds.name: Fan / Room Bed
sounds.description: Procedural steady fan / air-conditioner style bed. Smoother and warmer than white noise; steady with no pure tone.

sounds.name: Rain on Glass Noise
sounds.description: Procedural light rain taps over a soft rain bed, tuned to sit closer to a windowpane character than plain filtered noise. Synthetic bed, not a field recording.

sounds.name: Deep Water Bed
sounds.description: Procedural low filtered water-like movement with gentle surges. No animal sounds, no sudden splashes.

sounds.name: Ember Crackle Bed
sounds.description: Procedural warm noise bed with sparse soft crackles. Rounded crackles (not bright clicks); a texture bed, not a recording of a real fire.
sounds.notes: Weakest of the generated set; the crackles are deliberately subtle to stay sleep-safe. Treat as 'maybe' — review against the CC0 fireplace loops before featuring it.

sounds.name: Distant Thunder Bed
sounds.description: Procedural audition candidate: sparse distant low thunder rolls over a very quiet rumble floor. No rain, no sharp cracks, no field recording.
sounds.license_note: Generated by Nocturne scripts/generate_noise.py from Nocturne's local procedural thunder design; no third-party source audio.
sounds.notes: Audition candidate only; intentionally not a default slot until human sleep-safety review.

sounds.name: Soft Thunderstorm Bed
sounds.description: Procedural audition candidate: soft low thunder rolls with a faint rain hush. No bright thunder cracks, no field recording.
sounds.license_note: Generated by Nocturne scripts/generate_noise.py from Nocturne's local procedural thunder design; no third-party source audio.
sounds.notes: Audition candidate only; intentionally not a default slot until human sleep-safety review.
